sentences.zh: 没错，这就是为什么保罗辞去了剧集主管的职务，而格雷格又重新接手的原因。

sentences.en: The idea was that Rainn Wilson would do a half season of The Office and then The Farm would come out in January and then Rainn would leave The Office, do The Farm,
sentences.zh: 当时的构想是让雷恩·威尔森出演半季《办公室》，然后《农场》在一月份开播，接着雷恩离开《办公室》去拍《农场》，

sentences.en: and the two shows would overlap.
sentences.zh: 两部剧会有所重叠。

sentences.en: Another thing that we knew was that Ed Helms only signed up to do a half a year because he was going to leave in the middle to shoot The Hangover 3.
sentences.zh: 我们还知道，艾德·赫尔姆斯也只签了半年的合约，因为他中间要离开去拍《宿醉3》。

sentences.en: So we knew we would have Ed for a few episodes at the beginning and then a few at the end.
sentences.zh: 所以我们知道艾德在季初和季末会出演几集。

sentences.en: So the only sort of two like quote unquote lead characters that were left were me and John.
sentences.zh: 因此，剩下的所谓“主角”就只有我和约翰了。

sentences.en: And John wanted to do one more full year, but it kind of seemed like after that, we weren't sure if he was going to be up for a season 10.
sentences.zh: 约翰本来想再拍完整的一年，但看起来在那之后，我们不确定他是否还愿意拍第十季。

sentences.en: And I wasn't really sure how Pam was going to stay on The Office without Jim.
sentences.zh: 而且我真的不知道如果没有吉姆，帕姆该如何在《办公室》里待下去。

sentences.en: I was open to hearing options, but it did kind of seem like this was going to be Jim and Pam's last year all together.
sentences.zh: 我当时对各种选择持开放态度，但看起来这确实会是吉姆和帕姆在一起的最后一年了。

sentences.en: Yes, at Dunder Mifflin.
sentences.zh: 没错，在邓德·米夫林公司。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So as a result,
sentences.zh: 所以结果就是，

sentences.en: they asked John and I to come on this season as producers so that we could help direct the Jim and Pam storyline since it was going to be our last full year together on the show.
sentences.zh: 他们邀请我和约翰在这一季担任制片人，这样我们就能协助指导吉姆和帕姆的故事线，因为这将是我们在一起拍戏的最后一个完整年度。

sentences.en: And I have to applaud my BFF because all of a sudden this meant that you were going to have information that you couldn't share right away with me because you were now our producer.
sentences.zh: 我必须为我的好闺蜜鼓掌，因为这意味着你突然掌握了一些不能立刻告诉我的信息，因为你现在是我们的制片人了。

sentences.en: You were very professional.
sentences.zh: 你表现得非常专业。

sentences.en: You never spilled the beans on anything, even though I'm sure you wanted to.
sentences.zh: 你从来没有泄露过任何消息，尽管我肯定你当时很想说。

sentences.en: You, so professional BFF.
sentences.zh: 你真是个专业的闺蜜。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: It was actually very difficult.
sentences.zh: 其实这真的很难。

sentences.en: I know it was.
sentences.zh: 我知道很难。

sentences.en: And I tried not to bug you because I knew it was hard.
sentences.zh: 我尽量不去烦你，因为我知道这不容易。

sentences.en: And I appreciate that, Angela.
sentences.zh: 我很感激这一点，安吉拉。

sentences.en: Well, like I said, by the time the season was ready to premiere, we all knew it would be our last season and we did tons of press and interviews about it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，就像我说的，当这一季准备首播时，我们都知道这将是最后一季，我们为此做了大量的宣传和采访。

sentences.en: You can see all of them on officetelly.com.
sentences.zh: 你可以在officetelly.com上看到所有这些内容。

sentences.en: Angela, we are all so emotional.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，我们都太感性了。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: I watched a few.
sentences.zh: 我看了几个。

sentences.en: We're all very weepy.
sentences.zh: 我们都哭得稀里哗啦的。

sentences.en: Phyllis is like choking back tears the entire time she's being interviewed.
sentences.zh: 菲利斯在接受采访时全程都在强忍泪水。

sentences.en: And I feel like if you want to truly understand how emotional we all were, you just have to listen to Creed's interview because he does not make a single joke in the interview.
sentences.zh: 我觉得如果你想真正了解我们当时有多感性，你只需要听听克里德的采访，因为他在采访中一个笑话都没讲。

sentences.en: He's totally serious.
sentences.zh: 他非常严肃。

sentences.en: I have the audio clip.
sentences.zh: 我有那段音频片段。

sentences.en: Let's hear it.
sentences.zh: 让我们听听看。

sentences.en: I think we want to go out with a bang and raise our game and walk out of here feeling like we've, well, we already feel like we've been on a winning show and we've left a mark.
sentences.zh: 我想我们想以精彩的方式收尾，提升我们的表现，离开时感觉我们，嗯，我们已经觉得我们参与了一部成功的剧集，并且留下了自己的印记。

sentences.en: And, but obviously you want to take it up, take up the, take the bar, raise the bar a little bit higher.
sentences.zh: 而且，显然你想更进一步，把标准再提高一点。

sentences.en: So I think we're all pulling together as a team and not that we always haven't, but yeah, it's, it's kind of, I wouldn't say I'm not modeling about it, but it's been,
sentences.zh: 所以我认为我们都在齐心协力，并不是说我们以前没有这样做过，但确实，这有点，我不会说我对此感到伤感，但它已经，

sentences.en: it's this family, you know, it's going to be, it's going to be sad leaving these people.
sentences.zh: 这就像一个大家庭，你知道，离开这些人会让人很难过。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Oh yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Because Creed normally cuts stuff with a joke, you know, but that was just so honest and.
sentences.zh: 因为克里德通常会用笑话来结束话题，你知道，但那段话真的很真诚，而且。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I felt like it kind of summed up perfectly how we felt about it.
sentences.zh: 我觉得它完美地总结了我们当时的心情。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Are you ready for fast fact number two?
sentences.zh: 准备好听第二个快速事实了吗？

sentences.en: I am.
sentences.zh: 准备好了。

sentences.en: I'm just like, oh my gosh, am I going to be weepy this whole last season nine?
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得，天哪，难道我整个第九季最后一季都要泪流满面吗？

sentences.en: Maybe.
sentences.zh: 也许吧。

sentences.en: Maybe.
sentences.zh: 也许吧。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Well, fast fact number two is all about finding our new guys, Clark and Pete.
sentences.zh: 好了，第二个速览事实是关于我们如何找到新人的，也就是克拉克和皮特。

sentences.en: Yes, R.
sentences.zh: 没错，R。

sentences.en: Plop and Dwight Jr., who could have been called fart, but.
sentences.zh: “噗噗”和“小德怀特”，本来可以叫“屁屁”的，但是。

sentences.en: No, went another way.
sentences.zh: 没有，选了别的名字。

sentences.en: Went another way.
sentences.zh: 选了别的名字。

sentences.en: Well, we got a lot of fan mail.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了很多粉丝来信。

sentences.en: Corey Kaye from Illinois said, please tell us everything about the actors who played Clark and Plop.
sentences.zh: 来自伊利诺伊州的科里·凯说，请告诉我们关于饰演克拉克和“噗噗”的演员的一切。

sentences.en: Love these two additions to The Office.
sentences.zh: 很喜欢《办公室》里这两个新角色。

sentences.en: And Jamie D.
sentences.zh: 还有来自佐治亚州亚特兰大的杰米·D。

sentences.en: from Atlanta, Georgia said, I love the addition of Clark and Plop, especially Clark, who is in my top three favorite Office characters.
sentences.zh: 说，我喜欢克拉克和“噗噗”的加入，尤其是克拉克，他是我最喜欢的《办公室》角色前三名。

sentences.en: And I want to know everything about how he came to be.
sentences.zh: 我想知道关于他如何加入剧组的一切。

sentences.en: Give me the deets, please, and thank you.
sentences.zh: 请给我详细信息，谢谢。

sentences.en: Well, I reached out to our casting director, Allison Jones, to find out what exactly happened.
sentences.zh: 我联系了我们的选角导演艾莉森·琼斯，想弄清楚到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: How did we find these guys?
sentences.zh: 我们是怎么找到这些人的？

sentences.en: Allison said this was an extensive search.
sentences.zh: 艾莉森说这是一次大规模的搜寻。

sentences.en: She said not since she had to cast the role of Karen has she auditioned so many people for a role in The Office.
sentences.zh: 她说自从为《办公室》选凯伦这个角色以来，她还没为哪个角色试镜过这么多人。

sentences.en: I bet two new people coming in at this stage in the show.
sentences.zh: 我敢说，在剧集这个阶段引入两个新人确实不容易。

sentences.en: She said she auditioned people in New York.
sentences.zh: 她说她在纽约试镜了很多人。

sentences.en: She auditioned people in Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 她在洛杉矶也试镜了很多人。

sentences.en: And one of the reasons that they searched so intensely to cast these two actors was because at this point, there was an idea that The Office would continue into season 10.
sentences.zh: 他们之所以如此费力地寻找这两位演员，原因之一是当时有一种想法，认为《办公室》会继续拍到第十季。

sentences.en: Even if some of the regular cast members moved on, the idea was that these two new people were going to move us into the next generation of The Office.
sentences.zh: 即使一些常规演员离开，他们的想法是这两个新人将带领我们进入《办公室》的下一代。

sentences.en: And Clark Duke did an interview where he said, when Jake and I joined the show, the idea was that this was going to be a show like ER, where new leads could move in and out,
sentences.zh: 克拉克·杜克在一次采访中说，当我和杰克加入剧组时，大家的想法是这会像《急诊室的故事》那样，新的主角可以来来去去，

sentences.en: and it might run for like 20 years.
sentences.zh: 而且可能会播个20年左右。

sentences.en: So that was the vision.
sentences.zh: 这就是当时的愿景。

sentences.en: Allison wasn't just casting like guest stars or recurring characters.
sentences.zh: 艾莉森不仅仅是在选客串明星或常驻角色。

sentences.en: She was casting the next phase of The Office.
sentences.zh: 她是在选《办公室》的下一阶段人选。

sentences.en: The comedy ER.
sentences.zh: 喜剧版的《急诊室的故事》。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The 20 years in Dunder Mifflin just rotating people through this paper company.
sentences.zh: 在邓德·米夫林公司工作20年，人员不断轮换。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The most successful small paper company.
sentences.zh: 最成功的小型造纸公司。

sentences.en: With a documentary that never ends.
sentences.zh: 还有一部永远拍不完的纪录片。

sentences.en: Never ends.
sentences.zh: 永远拍不完。

sentences.en: Well, Allison knew Clark Duke, who was cast as Clark.
sentences.zh: 艾莉森认识饰演克拉克的克拉克·杜克。

sentences.en: He was cast firSt.
sentences.zh: 他最先被选中。

sentences.en: He had done a show called Clark and Michael, starring himself and Michael Cera.
sentences.zh: 他曾出演过一部名为《克拉克与迈克尔》的剧，由他和迈克尔·塞拉主演。

sentences.en: He was also in Hot Tub Time Machine with Craig Robinson and Kick-Ass.
sentences.zh: 他还和克雷格·罗宾逊一起演过《热浴盆时光机》，还演过《海扁王》。

sentences.en: He was sort of in that Judd Apatow comedy circle.
sentences.zh: 他算是贾德·阿帕图那个喜剧圈子里的人。

sentences.en: Allison thinks that he did not even audition, that they offered him the role.
sentences.zh: 艾莉森认为他甚至没有参加试镜，他们直接给了他这个角色。

sentences.en: So they got that done firSt.
sentences.zh: 所以这件事最先搞定了。

sentences.en: And I found an audio clip of Clark talking about joining the show.
sentences.zh: 我找到了一段克拉克谈论加入剧组的音频片段。

sentences.en: Would you like to hear it?
sentences.zh: 你想听听吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 想。

sentences.en: I was really flattered when they approached me about it.
sentences.zh: 当他们找我谈这件事时，我真的受宠若惊。

sentences.en: I'm a big fan of the show and have been since it started, I guess, nine years ago.
sentences.zh: 我是这部剧的忠实粉丝，我想从九年前开播起就是了。

sentences.en: And the British one before that.
sentences.zh: 在那之前还看过英版。

sentences.en: So I was very excited, thrilled to be a part of it.
sentences.zh: 所以我非常兴奋，能参与其中感到非常激动。

sentences.en: My character is also named Clark, which is convenient, because it's easy to remember, you know, on the call sheet, too.
sentences.zh: 我的角色也叫克拉克，这很方便，因为记起来很容易，你知道，在通告单上也一样。

sentences.en: You know, without giving it too much away, but there's really not, like, any big secrets.
sentences.zh: 你知道，虽然不能剧透太多，但其实也没什么大秘密。

sentences.en: My guy is just sort of a new guy that works at the office.
sentences.zh: 我演的这个角色只是办公室里的一个新人。

sentences.en: He's not, like, a secret agent or anything that's infiltrated the office.
sentences.zh: 他不是什么特工，也不是那种潜入办公室的人。

sentences.en: So there you go.
sentences.zh: 所以就是这样。

sentences.en: Well, I have two things to share about Clark and Jake.
sentences.zh: 嗯，关于克拉克和杰克，我有两件事要分享。

sentences.en: So since you're talking about Clark, we got into this conversation one day on set because his last name is Duke.
sentences.zh: 既然你在说克拉克，有一天我们在片场聊到了这个话题，因为他的姓是杜克。

sentences.en: And my mom's maiden name is Duke.
sentences.zh: 而我妈妈的娘家姓也是杜克。

sentences.en: And I was like, Clark, what if we're related?
sentences.zh: 我就说，克拉克，万一我们有亲戚关系呢？

sentences.en: And so then we started trying to figure it out.
sentences.zh: 于是我们就开始试着查清楚。

sentences.en: And he talked to his mom and I talked to my mom.
sentences.zh: 他去问了他妈妈，我也问了我妈妈。

sentences.en: And we're like, my mom was like, well, we did have some family that moved around.
sentences.zh: 我们当时就像，我妈说，嗯，我们确实有些亲戚搬来搬去过。

sentences.en: And so we sort of joked that we were maybe distant cousins.
sentences.zh: 所以我们就开玩笑说，也许我们是远房表亲。

sentences.en: But you never found out for sure?
sentences.zh: 但你们一直没查出个确切结果？

sentences.en: We never found out for sure.
sentences.zh: 我们一直没查出个确切结果。

sentences.en: But I did start sending his family my Christmas card.
sentences.zh: 但我确实开始给他的家人寄我的圣诞贺卡了。

sentences.en: Just in case.
sentences.zh: 以防万一。

sentences.en: Just in case.
sentences.zh: 以防万一。

sentences.en: And his mom would send me their Christmas card.
sentences.zh: 他妈妈也会给我寄他们的圣诞贺卡。

sentences.en: That is the sweetest thing.
sentences.zh: 这真是太贴心了。

sentences.en: I just love that.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢这个了。

sentences.en: Well, let's move on to Jake Lacey now, who got the role of Pete.
sentences.zh: 好了，现在我们来聊聊杰克·莱西，他得到了皮特这个角色。

sentences.en: Allison said that they read a couple hundred people for the role of Pete.
sentences.zh: 艾莉森说他们为皮特这个角色面试了几百人。

sentences.en: And eventually they settled on a handful of people.
sentences.zh: 最终他们选定了几个人。

sentences.en: They flew Jake in from New York to meet with Greg.
sentences.zh: 他们把杰克从纽约飞过来见格雷格。

sentences.en: And Jake did not have a lot of TV credits when he got the role in The Office.
sentences.zh: 杰克在得到《办公室》的角色时，并没有太多的电视作品。

sentences.en: He basically just killed it in his audition.
sentences.zh: 他基本上就是在试镜时表现得太棒了。

sentences.en: That is how he got the role.
sentences.zh: 这就是他得到角色的原因。

sentences.en: By the way, not having a lot of TV credits with Greg doesn't mean anything.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一下，在格雷格看来，没有太多电视作品根本不算什么。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That was the wonderful thing about all of us getting cast on The Office.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们所有人能被选入《办公室》最棒的地方。

sentences.en: He was like, I don't care about your experience.
sentences.zh: 他当时的态度是，我不在乎你的经验。

sentences.en: Are you great?
sentences.zh: 你够优秀吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Done.
sentences.zh: 行。

sentences.en: You get the job.
sentences.zh: 这工作归你了。

sentences.en: Jake did an interview at the start of the season where he said he had started watching The Office when he was in college and he was a huge fan of the show.
sentences.zh: 杰克在这一季开始时接受过一次采访，他说他在大学时就开始看《办公室》了，而且是这部剧的超级粉丝。

sentences.en: And I remember this, Angela.
sentences.zh: 我记得这件事，安吉拉。

sentences.en: I remember talking about this.
sentences.zh: 我记得我们聊过这个。

sentences.en: It made me feel very old on set.
sentences.zh: 这让我在片场感觉自己老了很多。

sentences.en: But here's the audio clip.
sentences.zh: 但这里有一段音频片段。

sentences.en: Yeah, this was definitely my dream job.
sentences.zh: 是的，这绝对是我梦寐以求的工作。

sentences.en: I think, you know, three months ago if you had said, there's any show, you pick it, you can be on it, I would have said The Office.
sentences.zh: 我想，你知道，如果三个月前你问我，有哪部剧，你随便挑，你可以去演，我会说是《办公室》。

sentences.en: And I was just blown away when this opportunity came up and then to get out here and test for it and think like, wow, it's getting close, you know.
sentences.zh: 当这个机会出现时，我简直惊呆了，然后来到这里试镜，心想，哇，离梦想成真越来越近了，你知道的。

sentences.en: And then to find out that I got it was thrilling, absolutely thrilling.
sentences.zh: 后来得知我被选上了，真是太令人激动了，绝对令人激动。

sentences.en: I mean, yeah, they were so young.
sentences.zh: 我是说，没错，他们太年轻了。

sentences.en: We were dinosaurs.
sentences.zh: 我们简直是老古董了。

sentences.en: I remember feeling very old around them.
sentences.zh: 我记得在他们身边感觉自己特别老。

sentences.en: Me too.
sentences.zh: 我也是。

sentences.en: I loved them.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢他们。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: They were wonderful.
sentences.zh: 他们太棒了。

sentences.en: And you know what?
sentences.zh: 而且你知道吗？

sentences.en: They were this really fun new energy.
sentences.zh: 他们带来了一种非常有趣的新活力。

sentences.en: They were the new guys.
sentences.zh: 他们是新人。

sentences.en: They were.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: It was great having them around.
sentences.zh: 有他们在身边感觉真好。

sentences.en: Here's my little thing about Jake Lacey.
sentences.zh: 关于杰克·莱西，我有个小故事。
